name: Ensenada

queries.query: Ensenada Baja California official cadastral map parcel GIS catastro predial
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Baja California predial page, the Ensenada municipal administration page listing Subdirección de Catastro, and a municipal notice describing IMIP's SIGME cadastral GIS. The official sources establish a local cadastral custodian and parcel-capable GIS, but no public anonymous parcel feature endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Ensenada Baja California sitio oficial catastro cartografía predial mapa parcelas
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial en español encontró la Subdirección de Catastro del Ayuntamiento, el IMIP y el SIGME. El Ayuntamiento describe capas catastrales hasta la identificación de predios y reporta cartografía de 168,248 predios en 2025; no se obtuvo una respuesta pública anónima acotada con identidad segura y geometría completa.

registry.custodian: XXV Ayuntamiento de Ensenada, Dirección de Administración Urbana, Ecología y Medio Ambiente, Subdirección de Catastro; municipal technical/geographic service by Instituto Metropolitano de Investigación y Planeación (IMIP).
registry.service: Sistema de Información Geográfica del Municipio de Ensenada (SIGME) and municipal Catastro services
registry.localCustodianEvidence: The official municipal administration page lists the Subdirección de Catastro and its valuation, property-registration and topography departments. The official IMIP notice says SIGME manages cadastral layers from the municipality polygon through identification of predios and, where applicable, condominium units.
registry.scope: Municipal cadastral/GIS coverage is evidenced; no claim is made that a public anonymous API or a city-boundary parcel extract is available. The 2026 municipal notice reports 168,248 predios cartographed in the municipal GIS during 2025.
registry.nationalOrGeneralAgencyEvidence: INEGI's Baja California carta catastral and the state law were used only as general reference; they are not treated as the local parcel service.

parcelEvidence.reason: No bounded anonymous public ID-plus-full-polygon response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point miss, login wall, maintenance page, or unavailable API is treated as citywide absence.
parcelEvidence.qualification: Not admitted as a runtime parcel adapter; serial review required.

researchNotes: The official municipal pages describe SIGME as a cadastral GIS and identify local Catastro/IMIP responsibility, which supports registryFound=true.
The municipal online-services portal displayed a maintenance notice and login prompt in accessible search material; no credentials were used.

Direct curl inspection of the official municipal HTTPS hosts was attempted with normal TLS verification; certificate validation failed locally, so TLS verification was not disabled and no certificate exception was used.
Only safe administrative, service, coverage, schema and geometry metadata were in scope. Owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, deed, registration and personal fields were not requested.
This packet records source research only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
